scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c mauve,blue "npm run -w @journal/api dev" "npm run -w @journal/web dev"
scripts.build: npm run -w @journal/shared build && npm run -w @journal/api build && npm run -w @journal/web build
scripts.deploy: fly deploy --build-arg GIT_SHA="$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)$(git diff --quiet HEAD || echo -dirty)" --build-arg BUILT_AT="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
